profile.headline: Data Engineer | Building Robust Data Pipelines
profile.summary: Data engineer with 10+ years in building large-scale data systems. Hands-on with Spark, Kafka, Airflow, AWS, and Delta Lake. Specialized in real-time processing, ETL pipelines, and cloud infrastructure that handles millions of daily transactions

positions.title: Software Engineer II (Data Loading)
positions.description:
• Architected mission-critical pricing infrastructure, enhancing Chewy's revenue and customer satisfaction.  
• Developed a robust data pipeline processing over 1M daily pricing events, achieving zero data loss.  
• Streamlined pricing operations by integrating multiple vendor data sources, reducing manual processes.  
• Enabled 40% faster price updates, supporting competitive pricing strategies in a dynamic market.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apache Spark · Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) · Python (Programming Language) · Spring Webflux

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Built enterprise pricing platform supporting dynamic price management across Macy's retail operations,
enabling data-driven pricing decisions based on geographic and performance variables.

• Developed a Unified Pricing Management System (UPMS) to enhance pricing strategies based on climate and sales performance.  
• Implemented a common service for price calculations using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Postgres.  
• Enhanced application performance through Redis Cache and executed performance testing with JMeter.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Developed core components of Verizon's B2B service portal, creating centralized account management
gateway that serves as the primary entry point for enterprise customers to access billing accounts and
manage wireless services across their organization.

• Collaborated with business analysts to refine user stories in Jira, enhancing project clarity.  
• Supported bi-weekly production releases, ensuring functionality met defined user stories.  
• Defined service inputs/outputs and provided APIs using Swagger UI for seamless integration.  
• Integrated legacy systems with Redis cache for efficient data exchange and performance monitoring.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
My Business Transform for Calling Plan Change (MBT-CPC), Verizon 

My business service portal is a web-based application to support B2B service. MBT-CPC is a service migration from a single monolithic service to multiple microservices for plan management for billing accounts and wireless numbers. 
• Worked with business analysts to write and refine user stories using Jira. 
• Defined input/output of services and provide APIs using Swagger UI.
• Implemented Services for current Plan and plan detail and usage information modules with Feign Web Service Client, Hibernate, and JPA.

Environment: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring REST, Spring Cloud, Eureka, Feign Service Client, Swagger API, Oracle, Elastic Search, Kibana, Junit/Mockito Unit Test, Jenkins, Jira, Gitlab, Agile Methodology

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Managed Service for Broker Portal/Employer Portal for Small/Medium Group, CareFirst

Broker portal is a web-based application to support brokers’ daily based tasks. From the portal, the users can manage and trace their benefit proposals and sales, member enrollments, group renewals, and billing tracking.  Employer portal for the small/medium group is a web-based application for employers with less than 200 employees. The portal provides users a platform to manage groups with functionalities such as enrolling members, paying their bills and accessing employees’ claims. 
     

• Analyzed root cause in incidents reported from system users.
• Fixed security vulnerabilities with the security team and UI developers.
• Managed and troubleshot development environment and system integration testing environments for the team members’ daily activities.
• Validated technical functionalities in post-production deployment.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Large Group Employer Portal Migration, CareFirst Owings Mill, MD

Large Group employer portal is a web system to support employers with 200+ employees under CareFirst to manage health insurance information. The system enables users to manage employee’s demographics, benefits, and coverage, and claim information. In addition, the system provides users to search and pay their bills from the portal. The project introduces Angular 5 and Spring MVC for provisioning responsive web user experience and separating front-end and back-end systems so that the change can convey a reliable and scalable system.
     
Responsibilities:
• Analyzed functions from the legacy system and transformed them into Spring MVC manner.
• Defined inputs, expected outputs, error/exception handling logic with UI developers.
• Extracted lending page dashboard data, managed authorization features/functions, and posted information alert using JMS.

Environment: Spring MVC with XML configuration/Hibernate, Oracle, TIBCO Web Service, JMS, IBM Web Sphere 9.0, Eclipse, IBM Urban Build/Urban Deploy

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
TicketGuard — airline ticket sales auditing platform

Built an ETL pipeline ingesting and normalizing text, XML, CSV, and Excel files into a relational database for ticket-sales audit and revenue-recovery reporting.

Automated audit report generation and distribution (PDF/Excel) for business users.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and enhanced the TicketGuard system for auditing flight ticket sales, improving data accuracy.  
• Implemented Java-based ETL processes for diverse data formats, ensuring seamless database integration.  
• Designed a user activity tracking system to analyze performance and enhance user satisfaction.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant at Advanced Java Programming class
Responsible for grading students' assignment.

positions.title: Business Rule Management System Engineer
positions.description:
Project Name: Integrated Monitoring System(IMS)

Description:
IMS is a centralized security system that facilitate detecting employees’ suspicious behavior pattern from system logs recorded in legacy security systems. Suspicious events are described by several scenarios depicted by Blaze Advisor based on an organization’s security policies and rules. All logs in data mart are analyzed by pre-defined scenarios. Scenarios are written to detect a single event, associate events, and aggregate behavior pattern. The result of analysis is reported to security managers daily. The main goal of the system is preventing information leak of the organization which cause profit loss.

Responsibilities:
•	Analyzed the business requirements and prepared use-case diagrams.
•	Analyzed the characteristics of logs and selected their required features.
•	Designed the detection scenarios from user requirement using Blaze Advisor
•	Designed and implemented batch module using Java J2SE, multi-threading, MS SQL procedures and Blaze Advisor.

Environment: Java, MS SQL 2008 R2, Blaze Advisor Java ver.7.0, MVC, JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax, Log4j, Eclipse, Tomcat.

Project Name: Tele-Underwriting System (TUS)

Description:
TUS is web based question-answering system driven by scripts or scenarios written by underwriter for targeting insurance companies. System users can register the questions, expected answers, and its coverage regarding specific diseases. The system enables the users to consult customers without underwriters’ knowledge by asking given questions to clients and the scenarios generate the result whether clients are accepted or denied and the coverage the client can receive. 

Responsibilities:
•	Implemented management of insurance products with JSP, jQuery, Ajax and servlet
•	Integrated e-disease manual from legacy system
•	Designed  disease search functions

Environment: Java, Sevlets, JSP, jQuery, Ajax, Mybatis, Oracle , Eclipse, SVN
